parsed.summary: The netlist implements the specified architecture with correct roles and values: PWM/serial jumper paths, MAX3485 UART transceiver with PNP auto-direction control, battery high-side P-FET switch, external 5V input diode, servo-rail low-drop diode, and the expected bulk/decoupling capacitors. Reference-designator shifts (e.g., D1/D2 labels) do not change the electrical behavior, and no short, open, wrong value, or wrong component role is supported by the files.
